$comment: Generated by scripts/build-tools.mjs from each Actor's public Apify input schema. Do not edit by hand; run `npm run build:tools`.

tools.name: publicrecords--google-ads-transparency-scraper
tools.title: Google Ads Transparency Scraper: Competitor Ads
tools.description:
Google Ads Transparency Scraper: Competitor Ads. Track competitors' Google ads by website or advertiser ID: new, running and stopped ads with first and last shown dates, days shown and ad links. No login, no proxy.

When to use: Use when you need the Google ads a competitor runs (by website domain, Google advertiser ID, Ads Transparency Center link or advertiser name): which ads are new, still running or stopped in a look-back window, with first and last shown dates, days shown and ad links, optionally for one country. Good for weekly competitor ad monitoring; not for ad spend, clicks or keyword bids.

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "publicrecords/google-ads-transparency-scraper" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/google-ads-transparency-scraper

targets.title: Competitors
targets.description: One per line: a website domain (nike.com), a Google advertiser ID (AR…), an Ads Transparency Center link, or an exact advertiser name. Example: ["nike.com"]

sinceDays.title: Look-back window (days)
sinceDays.description: Ads first shown in this window are "new"; ads that stopped inside it are "stopped". Google lists an ad 2–3 days after it runs, so on a schedule use your interval plus 3 days (10 for weekly) and match repeats by adId.

region.title: Region
region.description: Only ads shown in this country. "Anywhere" returns ads from every country.

statuses.title: Which ads
statuses.description: Leave all selected for every ad Google still lists (about one year back). Select only new, running and stopped for a faster weekly monitor.

maxAdsPerTarget.title: Max ads per competitor
maxAdsPerTarget.description: 0 means no limit. A website search returns every ad that links to it, which for big marketplaces is millions; use an advertiser ID for one company's own ads.

includeRegionStats.title: Add countries and EU impressions
includeRegionStats.description: Adds the countries each ad ran in and, for EU countries, Google's impression ranges. Slower: one extra request per ad.

annotations.title: Google Ads Transparency Scraper: Competitor Ads
